thread:
maria (AE): Ok team — Scout Labs POC kickoff tomorrow 9:00am PT. Leah sent a short list of asks: security questionnaire answers, pricing for a small Dedicated footprint (2 GPU nodes), and a concrete success criteria/eval plan. Need to align owners before the call. Agenda draft below. Who can own the sec questionnaire and infra runbook?

leah (Scout Labs): thanks — a couple quick clarifications from our side: we need SOC2 attestation or equivalent, data residency in eu-west-1, SSO (Okta), and the POC will run for 3 weeks with 3 power users. We also want a short prompt set to validate hallucination reduction.

maria (AE): noted. I'll cover stakeholder intro and success criteria alignment. Sam — can you cover technical discovery + infra ask? Natalie — pricing + run-rate estimates? Kevin — contract/security touchpoint?

sam (SE): I can own infra and the technical discovery. Quick discovery Qs to surface before the call: 1) expected QPS during peak? 2) avg + max prompt length (tokens)? 3) any regulated data (PHI/PII)? 4) will you need embeddings/reranking or only generation? 5) target latency SLA (p50/p95)?

leah (Scout Labs): peak ~25 rps for test traffic, typical prompt 350 tokens, max 1,200 tokens, will include PII (emails) but not PHI, we need encryption at rest and in transit, and SSO via Okta. Latency preference: p95 < 400ms.

sam (SE): good. For a 3-week POC with those sizes we recommend: - Dedicated 2 x A5000 (or equivalent) with autoscale burst to 4 for peak tests - enable KV cache and prefix caching for repeated prompts - quantized model variant for cost bound during eval

sam (SE): Suggested success metrics (proposal): - Functional: model answers >= 85% correctness on curated eval set (we'll define pass/fail per prompt) - Safety: hallucination incidents <= 1 per 1000 responses on eval prompts - Performance: p95 latency < 400ms under baseline test load (25 rps) - Cost: average token cost <$0.02 per 1k tokens for production path (goal, not blocker for POC)

sam (SE): Quick eval prompt examples (we'll refine):
```
# intent classification + answer grounding
Q1: "Summarize the customer's refund policy given this policy doc: <doc>"
Q2: "Given the user message, extract customer id and intent. Expected fields: {customer_id, intent, confidence}"
# hallucination test
Q3: "Does product X integrate with QuickPay? If yes, list the integration steps. If no, say 'no integration'."
```

natalie (Solutions Eng): Pricing note: for a short POC we can offer a trial credit to cover hosted costs. For Dedicated 2-node reserved monthly estimate: base platform fee $6,000/mo + GPU infra $3,000/mo/node (est) => ~12k/mo (pro-rated for POC). Add-ons: extra observability retention and private VPC are billable. I'll drop an itemized estimate in the follow-up.

kevin (Sales Eng): I'll handle the security questionnaire handoff to our security team and get SOC2 artifacts ready. @maria can you add Leah's legal contact? Also want to confirm procurement timeline — Leah, are we able to sign an MSA or do you need a PO?

leah (Scout Labs): legal will need an MSA. Procurement lead is mark@scoutlabs.co. We'll aim to complete signatures within 2 weeks after POC if results are good.

maria (AE): Perfect — owners: sam = tech discovery & infra runbook, natalie = pricing + estimate, kevin = security questionnaire & legal handoff, me = agenda + stakeholder intro and success criteria alignment. I'll update the kickoff slides and drop them into the meeting invite.

sam (SE): Prep checklist for tomorrow's call (quick bullets): - Confirm eval prompt list and who will author ground-truth answers - Confirm sample data (anonymized) to load into POC env - Confirm Okta SSO flow (SAML) + user test accounts - Decide on production vs quantized model variant for POC tests - Define simple smoke test harness (25 rps script)

maria (AE): I'll ask Leah to share the anonymized sample dataset and add Mark (legal) to the invite.

deploy-bot: Scheduled test cluster creation for scout-poc-sandbox at 2026-03-25T08:30:00Z (provisioning will be done by sam).

kevin (Sales Eng): One more ask — let's include a rollback/fallback plan in the runbook (what model variant to fallback to, and who to page). I'll draft that section.

leah (Scout Labs): great thanks everyone. Looking forward to the call — see you 9am PT.

maria (AE): Thanks — I'll post final agenda + invite notes in <#sales> before EOD. :thumbsup:
